You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE TV_Channel (
    id TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    series_name TEXT,
    Country TEXT,
    Language TEXT,
    Content TEXT,
    Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR TEXT,
    Hight_definition_TV TEXT,
    Pay_per_view_PPV TEXT,
    Package_Option TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id)
);

CREATE TABLE TV_series (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Episode TEXT,
    Air_Date TEXT,
    Rating TEXT,
    Share REAL,
    18_49_Rating_Share TEXT,
    Viewers_m TEXT,
    Weekly_Rank REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

CREATE TABLE Cartoon (
    id REAL   PRIMARY KEY,
    Title TEXT,
    Directed_by TEXT,
    Written_by TEXT,
    Original_air_date TEXT,
    Production_code REAL,
    Channel TEXT,
    UNIQUE (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (Channel) REFERENCES TV_Channel(id)
);

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT c.id,
       c.series_name
FROM TV_Channel AS c
JOIN Cartoon AS ct
  ON ct.Channel = c.id
ORDER BY c.series_name;
```
You need to find out which countries these tv channels are in.

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT c.Country
FROM TV_Channel AS c
JOIN Cartoon AS ct
  ON ct.Channel = c.id
WHERE c.Country IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.Country;
```
gotta make sure the tv channels are actually airing the cartoons we're talking about

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
       ch.id AS channel_id,
       ch.series_name AS channel_name,
       ch.Country,
       ct.id AS cartoon_id,
       ct.Title AS cartoon_title,
       ct.Original_air_date
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS ct
  ON ct.Channel = ch.id
ORDER BY ch.series_name, ct.Title;
```
we should also check if these cartoons are written by Todd Casey

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT
       ch.id AS channel_id,
       ch.series_name AS channel_name,
       ch.Country,
       ct.id AS cartoon_id,
       ct.Title AS cartoon_title,
       ct.Written_by,
       ct.Original_air_date
FROM TV_Channel AS ch
JOIN Cartoon AS ct
  ON ct.Channel = ch.id
WHERE ct.Written_by = 'Todd Casey'
ORDER BY ch.series_name, ct.Title;
```
